name: Activity Monitor
author: Kristoffer Haugland
description: A calm, low-overhead glance at CPU, memory, GPU, storage, and processes — with a die that matches your chip

barWidget.description: A calm system glance with an expandable process view and a CPU die that matches your hardware.

schema.label: Update speed
schema.description: Efficient uses fewer samples; Fast makes the graphs react sooner.

schema.label: Process power estimates
schema.description: Disable to skip CPU package-energy sampling in the detailed view.

schema.label: Show CPU in bar
schema.description: Add a live CPU percentage next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Show memory in bar
schema.description: Add a live memory percentage next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Show GPU in bar
schema.description: Add a live GPU percentage next to the bar icon; keeps GPU sampling warm in the background.

schema.label: Show icons in bar
schema.description: Prefix each enabled bar metric with its own icon instead of a plain dot separator.
